identity.name: Evergrene
identity.notes: Evergrene is one of the largest gated non-country club communities in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, spanning 400 acres with large lakes and preserved natural areas. It is an Audubon International Gold-Rated Signature Sanctuary, with over 50% of its land devoted to upland preserves, landscaped buffers, common area green space, and water bodies including 3.2 miles of shoreline. The community features a 20,000 sq ft clubhouse, resort-style heated pool, and extensive recreational amenities. HOA fees are notably higher than most other communities in the area.

fees.note: HOA fees are described as 'noticeably higher than in most other communities in the area' but no exact amount is stated. Residents say the fees buy 'a fabulous country club living at a greatly reduced cost.'

HOA fee field is present but value not displayed in the source. Association: EVERGRENE MASTER ASSOCIATION, INC., established 12/14/2001, Federal ID 010548995. Property Manager: FPMS, 5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota FL 34231, 941-960-5000.
Median housing costs in the neighborhood are $2,012/month per census data. Median gross rent approximately $2,2xx (figure truncated in source).

Listed as '$569 (SF)' in Munara/housevaluelab key features, presumably single-family HOA dues; page context is ambiguous and the site describes Evergrene fees only as 'noticeably higher than most other communities in the area'. Not verified against the association. For reference, hoa-agent.com states the average monthly HOA fee in Palm Beach Gardens is ~$641 and that Evergrene Master Association's fee has not yet been verified by residents (managed by Castle Group). No CDD special assessment data found on any page read (hoa-agent reports 'no assessment signals').

No specific Evergrene fee amount published; profile (updated Aug 3, 2026) marks fee as unverified. Utilities: FPL electric, Seacoast Utility Authority water/sewer, Solid Waste Authority of Palm Beach County trash.
